# Vendored crates

This directory holds our own retargeted copies of two third-party crates.
They are referenced from the workspace root `Cargo.toml` by path.

## Provenance

| Crate | Upstream version | Source | Upstream repository |
|-------|------------------|--------|---------------------|
| `iced_aw` | 0.13.1 | crates.io | https://github.com/iced-rs/iced_aw |
| `iced_fonts` | 0.3.0 | crates.io | https://github.com/Redhawk18/iced_fonts |

Both were taken from the published crates.io packages, not from git.

## Why vendored

The upstream releases are pinned to iced 0.14. Signex builds against the
`alplabai/iced` fork at 0.15.0-dev, whose widget, overlay and layout APIs differ.
The crates are vendored so they can depend on the fork's `iced_core` and
`iced_widget` and carry the API port.

## Modifications

- Dependencies (`iced_core`, `iced_widget`) retargeted from iced 0.14 to the
  `alplabai/iced` fork, version 0.15.0-dev.
- `iced_aw`: source ported to the fork's API (overlay layout computed at creation,
  `flex::resolve` on widget trees, and similar changes).
- `iced_fonts`: reduced to an empty stub. All font-embedding modules, the
  `bootstrap`, `codicon`, `devicon`, `fontawesome`, `lucide`, `material`, `nerd`,
  `octicons`, `pomicons` and `full` features, and every `include_bytes!` were
  removed, along with `iced_fonts/fonts/` and `iced_fonts/assets/`. Only the
  `advanced_text` feature is kept because `iced_aw` enables it. The crate is
  still needed: `iced_aw` depends on it (and re-exports it), and the workspace
  `[patch.crates-io]` entry points at it. It must compile under
  `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features` (vendored path crates
  are workspace members), which would otherwise enable every font feature.
- `iced_aw`: `images/` (showcase PNG/GIF screenshots and concept SVGs) removed.
  Nothing compiles or includes them; the showcase image links in
  `iced_aw/README.md` were deleted. The three menu documentation screenshots in
  `iced_aw/src/widget/menu/images/` are still referenced by
  `iced_aw/src/widget/menu/README.md` and were kept.
- Examples, tests directories and benches removed.
- Repository tooling removed: `.github/`, `.cargo/`, `.vscode/`, `.envrc`,
  `flake.nix`, `flake.lock`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `tarpaulin.toml`,
  `.gitignore`, `Cargo.lock`, `Cargo.toml.orig`, `.cargo_vcs_info.json`.
- Line endings normalized to LF.
- Compiler warnings fixed in `iced_aw`: unused variables and imports, never-read
  overlay fields, unused `Axis::Horizontal` in `menu/flex.rs` (the menu-local flex
  only lays out vertically). Unused manifest keys (`wasm_js`, `advanced`) removed.

## Why the font files were dropped

They were never compiled in (every `include_bytes!` in `iced_fonts/src/lib.rs`
was feature-gated, `iced_aw` enables only `advanced_text`, and nothing in
`crates/` names `iced_fonts`), and several carry licences this repo does not
accept (see CONTRIBUTING.md, which allows only permissive licences for code and
CC0 for non-software assets): `codicon.ttf` (CC BY 4.0), `nerd.ttf` (bundles
codicons), and `FontAwesome.otf` (OFL 1.1, shipped without its licence text).

## Licences

Both crates are MIT licensed. Each keeps its upstream `LICENSE` file
(`iced_aw/LICENSE`, `iced_fonts/LICENSE`); these must be retained.

`iced_fonts` no longer contains any font or other non-code asset.

The one font-like asset still compiled in is `iced_aw/font.ttf`
(`ICED_AW_FONT_BYTES`, six glyphs: cancel, ok, and up/down/left/right-open). Its
`name` table says "Copyright (C) 2025 by original authors @ fontello.com" and
"Generated by svg2ttf from Fontello project". The crate ships no Fontello
`config.json`, README or licence file, so the glyph-set licences are NOT
determinable from this repository. The glyph names match Fontello's Entypo set
(CC BY 4.0), but that is a guess and not confirmed. Until the source set is
established, treat this font's licence as unknown; replacing it with
hand-drawn or CC0 glyphs would remove the question.

## Out of scope for repo guards

`vendor/` is outside the licence-guard (`.github/workflows/license-guard.yml`)
and the god-file scripts; nothing there checks vendored files, so their
contents are reviewed by hand.

## Manifests

The `Cargo.toml` files began as the normalised manifests from crates.io (with
an "automatically generated" header). They have been edited by hand and
`Cargo.toml.orig` is not kept, so each now carries a note saying so instead.
